title: WabbleSpec Task Card Contract
description: Contract schema for .wabblespec/state/plans/task-card.md. Task-card is markdown — this schema is a machine-readable reference contract for Guard Layer 1 prose validation and human authoring. Required sections and fields are listed here; Guard checks presence of each required field by name in the markdown frontmatter block.

goal.description: One sentence. Falsifiable — true or false when the task is complete. No 'and' clauses.

target.description: Build target from recipe.json. Must match a declared platform module.

complexity.description: Complexity tier. Determines minimum criteria count: Low=2-4, Medium=4-8, High=8-12.

locked_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when task card was locked by user confirmation.

change_class.description: Change classification. Must match delta_class in specify-receipt.json. Determines Migrate activation and Archive version bump.

non_goals.description: At least one explicit non-goal. Transferred verbatim from scope.md.

assumptions.description: At least one assumption. Transferred verbatim from scope.md.

acceptance_criteria.description: GWT or EARS criteria. Each 'then' must be verifiable. Low: 2-4, Medium: 4-8, High: 8-12.

$comment: Guard Layer 1 validates markdown task-card by checking presence of: goal, target, complexity, locked_at, change_class, Non-Goals section (>=1 item), Assumptions section (>=1 item), Acceptance Criteria section (>=1 criterion). Full JSON validation applies only if task-card is serialised as JSON. Markdown validation is prose-based per the Guard SKILL.md Layer 1 rules.
